ko: 두 사람은 서로 한 걸음씩 양보해 현실적인 방안으로 타협했어요.
de: Beide Seiten gaben etwas nach und einigten sich auf eine realistische Lösung.
en: Both sides gave a little and reached a realistic compromise.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=타협하다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 주관이 다르다고 해서 상대의 판단이 틀린 것은 아니에요.
de: Nur weil sich subjektive Sichtweisen unterscheiden, ist die Einschätzung der anderen Person nicht falsch.
en: A different subjective view does not make the other person's judgment wrong.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=주관; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 이번 결정에서는 빠른 결과보다 오래 지킬 수 있는 기준을 우선시하려고 해요.
de: Bei dieser Entscheidung möchte ich einen Maßstab priorisieren, den ich langfristig einhalten kann.
en: For this decision, I want to prioritize a standard I can uphold over time.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=우선시하다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 의견 차이를 줄이려면 서로가 받아들일 수 있는 양보가 필요해요.
de: Um unterschiedliche Meinungen einander anzunähern, braucht es Zugeständnisse, die beide Seiten akzeptieren können.
en: To narrow a difference of opinion, both sides need concessions they can accept.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=양보; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 그는 어려운 상황에서도 남을 성급히 판단하지 않겠다는 신념을 지켰어요.
de: Auch in schwierigen Situationen hielt er an seiner Überzeugung fest, andere nicht vorschnell zu beurteilen.
en: Even in difficult situations, he held on to his conviction not to judge others too quickly.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=신념; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 무엇이 중요한지에 대한 기준이 다르면 같은 선택도 다르게 보일 수 있어요.
de: Wenn sich die Maßstäbe dafür unterscheiden, was wichtig ist, kann dieselbe Wahl unterschiedlich wirken.
en: When people use different criteria for what matters, the same choice can look different.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=기준; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 회의에서는 비용보다 안전을 우선해야 한다는 이견이 제기됐어요.
de: In der Sitzung wurde die abweichende Meinung vorgebracht, Sicherheit müsse vor Kosten stehen.
en: At the meeting, someone raised the view that safety should come before cost.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=이견; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 두 제안의 장점을 살린 절충안을 찾으면 갈등을 줄일 수 있어요.
de: Eine Kompromisslösung, die die Stärken beider Vorschläge aufgreift, kann Konflikte verringern.
en: A compromise that keeps the strengths of both proposals can reduce conflict.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=절충안; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 관리자는 결정의 결과를 설명할 책무가 있어요.
de: Leitende Personen haben die Verantwortung, die Folgen ihrer Entscheidungen zu erklären.
en: Leaders have a responsibility to explain the consequences of their decisions.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=책무; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 정보가 충분하지 않아도 어느 순간에는 결단을 내려야 할 때가 있어요.
de: Auch wenn Informationen fehlen, kommt der Moment, in dem man eine Entscheidung treffen muss.
en: Even without complete information, there comes a time when you have to make a decision.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=결단; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 모두가 반대해도 자신의 소신을 차분히 설명했어요.
de: Obwohl alle anderer Meinung waren, erklärte sie ihre eigene Überzeugung ruhig.
en: Even though everyone disagreed, she calmly explained her own conviction.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=소신; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 그 선택이 남긴 영향을 되돌아보며 다음 기준을 세웠어요.
de: Im Rückblick auf die Folgen dieser Wahl habe ich einen neuen Maßstab für die nächste Entscheidung gesetzt.
en: Reflecting on the effects of that choice, I set a new criterion for my next decision.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=되돌아보다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 짧은 문장이었지만 읽고 난 뒤에도 긴 여운이 남았어요.
de: Der Satz war kurz, aber er klang noch lange nach, nachdem ich ihn gelesen hatte.
en: It was a short sentence, but it stayed with me long after I had read it.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=여운; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 작가는 직접 말하지 않고 한 장면에 여러 감정을 함축했어요.
de: Die Autorin sprach es nicht direkt aus, sondern verdichtete mehrere Gefühle in einer Szene.
en: The author did not say it directly but condensed several feelings into one scene.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=함축; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 비가 그친 거리의 묘사가 장면을 눈앞에 그리게 했어요.
de: Die Beschreibung der Straße nach dem Regen ließ die Szene vor meinem inneren Auge entstehen.
en: The description of the street after the rain brought the scene to life.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=묘사; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 낯선 사람을 바라보는 화자의 시선이 글 전체의 분위기를 만들어요.
de: Der Blickwinkel der erzählenden Person auf die Fremden prägt die Stimmung des ganzen Textes.
en: The narrator's perspective on the strangers shapes the mood of the whole text.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=시선; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 저는 주인공이 말하지 못한 불안에 더 공감했어요.
de: Ich konnte besonders mit der Angst mitfühlen, die die Hauptfigur nicht aussprechen konnte.
en: I especially empathized with the anxiety the main character could not put into words.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=공감하다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 같은 문장도 독자의 경험에 따라 여러 방식으로 해석될 수 있어요.
de: Derselbe Satz kann je nach Erfahrung der lesenden Person unterschiedlich interpretiert werden.
en: The same sentence can be interpreted in different ways depending on the reader's experience.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=해석; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 첫 문단의 차분한 인상이 마지막의 긴장과 대조됐어요.
de: Der ruhige Eindruck des ersten Abschnitts stand im Kontrast zur Spannung am Ende.
en: The calm impression of the first paragraph contrasted with the tension at the end.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=인상; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 반복해서 나오는 창문은 인물의 망설임을 보여 주는 상징처럼 느껴졌어요.
de: Das wiederkehrende Fenster wirkte wie ein Symbol für das Zögern der Figur.
en: The recurring window felt like a symbol of the character's hesitation.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=상징; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 시간 순서를 바꾼 서술 덕분에 결말의 의미가 더 또렷해졌어요.
de: Durch die veränderte zeitliche Erzählweise wurde die Bedeutung des Endes deutlicher.
en: Changing the order of time in the narration made the ending clearer.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=서술; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 누군가를 용서하는 장면이 제게 가장 큰 울림을 줬어요.
de: Die Szene, in der jemand vergeben wird, hat mich am stärksten berührt.
en: The scene in which someone is forgiven resonated with me the most.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=울림; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 밝은 배경과 무거운 대사의 대조가 인물의 외로움을 드러냈어요.
de: Der Gegensatz zwischen hellem Hintergrund und schweren Worten machte die Einsamkeit der Figur sichtbar.
en: The contrast between the bright setting and the heavy dialogue revealed the character's loneliness.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=대조; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 글을 읽고 난 뒤 제 행동을 돌아보는 성찰의 시간이 필요했어요.
de: Nach der Lektüre brauchte ich Zeit, um über mein eigenes Verhalten nachzudenken.
en: After reading the text, I needed time to reflect on my own actions.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=성찰; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 같은 뜻이라도 '부탁'과 '요구'는 어감이 달라요.
de: Auch wenn beide Wörter Ähnliches bedeuten, haben 부탁 und 요구 eine andere Klangwirkung.
en: Even though they have a similar meaning, 부탁 and 요구 carry different connotations.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=어감; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 답변의 내용보다 차가운 말투가 더 불편하게 느껴졌어요.
de: Mehr als der Inhalt der Antwort wirkte der kühle Sprechton unangenehm.
en: More than the content of the reply, its cold tone felt uncomfortable.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=말투; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 사전의 용례를 보면 이 표현이 어떤 상황에서 쓰이는지 알 수 있어요.
de: An den Verwendungsbeispielen im Wörterbuch erkennt man, in welchen Situationen dieser Ausdruck gebraucht wird.
en: Dictionary usage examples show the situations in which this expression is used.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=용례; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 관용어는 낱말을 그대로 번역하면 뜻이 잘 전달되지 않을 수 있어요.
de: Bei Redewendungen geht die Bedeutung leicht verloren, wenn man die einzelnen Wörter wörtlich übersetzt.
en: With idiomatic expressions, the meaning can be lost when the words are translated literally.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=관용어; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 공식 안내문에서는 상황에 맞는 격식을 지키는 것이 중요해요.
de: In einer offiziellen Mitteilung ist es wichtig, ein zur Situation passendes Maß an Formellheit zu wahren.
en: In an official notice, it is important to use a level of formality that fits the situation.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=격식; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 비속어는 가까운 사이에서도 상대에 따라 무례하게 들릴 수 있어요.
de: Auch unter vertrauten Menschen kann derbe Sprache je nach Gegenüber unhöflich wirken.
en: Even among close people, slang can sound rude depending on who hears it.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=비속어; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 거절할 때는 이유를 덧붙이면 표현이 더 완곡해져요.
de: Wenn man bei einer Ablehnung einen Grund ergänzt, wirkt die Formulierung indirekter und schonender.
en: Adding a reason when you decline makes the wording more indirect and considerate.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=완곡하다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 한때 유행한 표현도 시간이 지나면 더 이상 널리 통용되지 않을 수 있어요.
de: Auch ein Ausdruck, der einmal beliebt war, kann mit der Zeit nicht mehr allgemein gebräuchlich sein.
en: Even an expression that was once popular may no longer be widely used over time.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=통용되다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 새로운 말이 여러 세대에 자연스럽게 쓰이면 일상어로 정착할 수 있어요.
de: Wenn ein neues Wort von mehreren Generationen selbstverständlich verwendet wird, kann es sich als Alltagssprache etablieren.
en: When a new word is naturally used across generations, it can become established in everyday language.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=정착하다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 의도를 설명하지 않은 짧은 답장은 불필요한 오해를 낳기 쉬워요.
de: Eine kurze Antwort ohne Erklärung der Absicht kann leicht unnötige Missverständnisse hervorrufen.
en: A short reply that does not explain its intent can easily cause unnecessary misunderstandings.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=오해를 낳다; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 같은 의견도 표현 방식에 따라 상대가 받아들이는 느낌이 달라져요.
de: Je nach Art der Formulierung kann dieselbe Meinung beim Gegenüber anders ankommen.
en: The same opinion can land differently depending on how it is phrased.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=표현 방식; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft

ko: 여러 상황의 대화를 비교해 보면 상황에 맞는 언어 감각이 자라요.
de: Wenn man Gespräche aus verschiedenen Situationen vergleicht, entwickelt sich ein Gespür für passende Sprache.
en: Comparing conversations from different situations builds a feel for language that fits the context.
field_notes: Batch 03; vocab=언어 감각; rights: original; exact canonical vocab example in draft
